method:
(conservative, documented on the page):
- Weekly ATR (wATR) = 14-week mean true range from daily candles, as of the plan's creation day.
- Fill probability for a buy rung d wATR under price = empirical share of past weeks (this name's own history,
  up to 6 years) in which price dipped at least d wATR within the next 8 weeks. Sell targets: same, upward.
- Win probability after a fill = average of the barrier odds ln(B/K)/ln(T/K) (target T before kill K) and the
  engine's out-of-sample backtest hit rate, times 0.9 (haircut). Kill exits assume 2% slippage; fees per side
  from core.P['FEE'].
- Best = every rung fills and reaches its first target. Worst = every rung fills and is stopped at the kill.
- Actual = API fills matched to rungs (same ticker, right side, price within 1% of the level, between the plan's
  creation and its retirement). Placed = an open order in results/open_orders.json within 1% of the level.
- Missed (planned, not placed) = candle touched the level within 0.5% while active and no API order/fill:
  hypothetical P&L as if it had been placed, marked to the latest close (kill on weekly close applies).
- Cost of changing = old version's hypothetical result since it was retired minus the new version's over the
  same window (positive = the change helped).
